name: Roman Hölzl
headline: Co-founder & CEO of RobCo — Automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary
summary:
RobCo’s purpose is to automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary

Gone are the days when a manufacturing company could do everything with human labor alone. Today, the only way to compete is to automate, but current automation solutions are anything but automatic.

To assemble even a simple automation solution, you have to stitch bits and pieces together. Once you have all the pieces you then have to figure out how to get them to work together. This means paying a systems integrator to figure out how to get the thing up and running. The whole process can take months to quarters. And you have to pay everything upfront – a huge CapEx cost that kills your balance sheet.

And for what? A brittle system that only works on one task and requires paying additional fees if anything goes wrong. And that's in the best case scenario. On the job it's a different story; the ground truth is sobering. Things break. Requirements change. Suddenly your automation robot feels destined to be an expensive, automatic disaster. But you do it anyway. Because human labor alone is not enough. Today's world moves too quickly to do everything by hand, even if you've got strong and capable hands. There has to be a different way.

Different, not better: RobCo is different. We asked ourselves: what if we could shift the industry from bespoke hardware to autonomous, adaptable, and affordable robot solutions? Then you could solve problems at a pace and a price that today's manufacturing demands. 

Transforming our customers: We've created a system that gets a full end-to-end robotics solution in place in weeks and can change as your needs change. You only pay a low monthly fee, instead of a huge upfront expense, and then watch as your efficiency (and safety and worker happiness) all dramatically improve. And when your business changes, we shift with you. Instantly and seamlessly adapting to the new process or requirements, helping you get more done, no matter what the job is. RobCo's purpose is exactly that: To automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary.

company.name: RobCo
company.tagline: RobCo’s vision is to automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary
company.description:
RobCo's mission is to automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraodinary. 

Founded in 2020 out of the Technical University of Munich, RobCo is on a mission to make industrial automation more accessible, affordable, and adaptable. Its patented modular hardware kit, combined with the RobCo Studio no-code software platform, allows industrial companies of all sizes to automate repetitive and dangerous tasks quickly and with unmatched flexibility. Whether it’s machine tending, palletizing, dispensing, or welding, RobCo’s modular robot kits provide versatile end-to-end solutions that are simple to deploy and manage remotely — without heavy upfront investment or specialist expertise. With offices in Munich and San Francisco and robots already in operation worldwide, RobCo is supercharging a new generation of industrial companies to reduce costs, boost productivity, and compete on a global stage.
